case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear Andreas Moser,

thank you for your offer and for the reliable cooperation. We would like to settle this in a way that works for both sides. We can commit for the longer term, which gives you planning security: 24 months. On that basis we propose option A: EUR 47.64 per unit, payment 30 days net, a 24-month contract, valid from 2027-04-01; option B: EUR 48.02 per unit, payment 60 days net, a 24-month contract, valid from 2027-04-01.

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your proposal and the commitment to a 24-month contract, which provides valuable planning security for both our companies. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. 

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. For our main Angebot, we can present a price of €51.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. However, delaying the effective date to April 2027 is not feasible given the cost increases we have already absorbed. Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: €51.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Please note that this proposal remains valid for 30 days. We value our long relationship and look forward to continuing our partnership.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
